description.value: Lakeside is Harrison Hot Springs Resort's family breakfast restaurant, perched on the second floor of the East Tower with sweeping views of Harrison Lake and the Coastal Mountains. It serves a traditional breakfast buffet featuring cereals, pancakes, waffles, eggs Benedict, and other classic morning fare. Located within the resort complex in the heart of Harrison Hot Springs, it is accessible to non-resort guests and is a natural stop for cyclists exploring the area.
